messages:
Maria H: Heads up — Legal just asked us to place a 12-month hold on raw auth and session logs for a customer investigation. Need suggestions on secure storage + access controls.
Jake L: ok, is this a full account hold or scoped to specific customer IDs / time ranges?
Maria H: scoped to customer_id=acme-corp and timeframe 2026-02-01..2026-03-10. They want raw logs (no pre-redaction) retained separately from normal lifecycle.
Ashley P: We should not mix those with normal retention buckets. Propose an "evidence-lake" S3 bucket (encrypted) with a custom KMS CMK that has an explicit key policy only allowing: KMS decrypt by kms-proxy role + on-call forensic role with JIT grants.
DevOps-Jen: We can create lifecycle rules to suspend deletion for that prefix and prevent lifecycle transitions. Need to ensure object lock/legal-hold flags if available.
Paul G: Also call out: SIEM exports that normally redact PII will need a parallel export pipeline that ships the unredacted bundle into evidence-lake. That export must be authenticated and auditable.
Jake L: How do we do the JIT grants? We don't want permanent roles that can view raw logs.
Ashley P: Workflow idea:
1) Create IAM role forensic-jit-reader that has s3:GetObject for evidence-lake but no permanent AssumeRole.
2) Tying AssumeRole to ticket approval in Jira (SEC-####) via short-lived session (1h) using an internal approval lambda.
3) KMS CMK grants are timeboxed: the decrypt grant is issued to the forensic-jit-reader principal only during the approved window.
This avoids needing to change the CMK key policy frequently.
Maria H: That covers access. What about SIEM export integrity? We need tamper-proof evidence.
Paul G: Add HMAC checksum metadata on each object and publish a manifest to a write-once prefix with object hashes. Also enable S3 Object Lock in Compliance mode for the affected prefixes.
DevOps-Jen: Example export command (simplified):
```
# SIEM collector (export unredacted) -> evidence-lake
aws s3 cp /tmp/export_acme_20260220.json s3://evidence-lake/acme-corp/2026-02-20/export.json \ 
  --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id alias/evidence-cmk --metadata "checksum=sha256:..."
```
Ensure the collector IAM has PutObject and cannot list the whole bucket.
Ashley P: KMS notes: don't allow key decryption to wide groups. Key policy should allow keystore admin ops and explicit grants to the forensic-jit-reader during windows. Rotate the key on schedule but keep rotation transparent for access logs.
Jake L: For audit trails, we need CloudTrail entries for: PutObject, GetObject, KMS:Decrypt grants, and any AssumeRole. How long should those audit events be kept?
Maria H: Legal wants the logs for the 12-month period plus metadata for at least 3 years after access. We'll store CloudTrail logs in a separate immutability bucket with 3y retention.
Paul G: Ok. One more security concern: vulnerability triage. If we see CVE exploitation attempts we need full packet/flow logs. Should we include firewall/edge logs in the evidence-lake?
Ashley P: Edge logs can be huge. Suggest we capture matched windows (5m around suspicious activity) and ship those to evidence-lake rather than everything. SIEM can mark an event which triggers a short-run exporter that pulls the relevant logs and stores them with a correlated manifest id.
Maria H: Incident response: update playbook step 2 to "preserve evidence (call export job)" with owner and ticket id.
DevOps-Jen: I'll add a terraform module that creates:
- s3://evidence-lake with object-lock enabled (prefix-based)
- alias/evidence-cmk with restricted policy
- terraform-managed aws_lambda for JIT approvals
Will also add bucket policy to deny DeleteObject unless from lifecycle-service with a specific tag.
Jake L: RBAC change requests: We'll need two roles added to IAM console: forensic-jit-requestor (can request) and forensic-jit-reader (assumed after approval). Also a new GitHub team for reviewers.
Maria H: Action items:
- DevOps-Jen: terraform module + object-lock config + lifecycle exemptions (owner: @DevOps-Jen)
- Ashley P: draft KMS key policy + grant workflow docs (owner: @Ashley P)
- Paul G: SIEM export blueprint + manifest/HMAC pattern (owner: @Paul G)
- Jake L: update incident playbook and RBAC request template (owner: @Jake L)
- Maria H: open legal ticket with exact customer/time ranges (owner: @Maria H)
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026-457 and linked to this thread :white_check_mark:
Maria H: Thanks — can we aim to have the terraform + draft policies in a week? I'll chase legal for the exact hold language. :thumbsup:
